description: This Java source file defines the VerifyPickServices class, which provides static methods for verifying, completing, and cancelling pick sessions within a shipment verification process in an Apache OFBiz framework application.

classes.name: VerifyPickServices
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for managing pick verification sessions and their lifecycle, including verification of individual or bulk items, completing a pick, and cancelling all pending operations.

methods.name: verifySingleItem
methods.description: Verifies a single item by creating a row in the VerifyPickSession with details from input context, such as order ID, product ID, quantity, and location. Handles exceptions related to general errors during creation.

methods.name: verifyBulkItem
methods.description: Verifies multiple items in bulk by iterating over selected entries, extracting details like order item ID, product ID, quantity, and origin location, and creating corresponding rows in the VerifyPickSession.

methods.name: completeVerifiedPick
methods.description: Completes the verification process for a given order ID, finalizes the shipment, clears all verification rows, and handles exceptions during completion.

methods.name: cancelAllRows
methods.description: Cancels all pending verification rows in the current VerifyPickSession.
